title: Use ranked in resumeRows, fileRows and cardRows instead of hand-rolled fuzzy ranking
notes:
resumeRows (src/shared/chat/chat-commands.ts), fileRows (src/renderer/chat/chat-mentions.ts) and the title half of cardRows (src/renderer/board/card-search.ts) re-spell the score, filter and stable sort that ranked in src/shared/app/fuzzy.ts does, each with an extra tie-break that a pre-sort before ranked expresses (newest first, shorter path then name, board order), as rewindRows now reverses first. Cost: a change to how ranked breaks ties or skips an empty query reaches the picker, /model, /rewind and /effort but not /resume, the @ file list or the board search; the empty-query early return from #146 already does not reach fileRows, which scores and sorts every file when @ is typed alone.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/150
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/146#discussion_r4435526462

comments.body: Shipped in #153: resumeRows, fileRows and cardRows call ranked, which now takes an optional tie-break (newest first for /resume, shorter path first for @, board order for the search).
Shipped in PR #153: /resume, the @ file list and the board search are ranked by fuzzy match. Merged after a clean review round.
